# std/break

> Leave the innermost loop: break

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/break.pkg) · translated by [bintables/break](../bintables/break.md)

```
let i = 0
while true
  if i == 3
    break
  end
  i = i + 1
end
```

Only allowed inside a loop (`while`, `for`).
